title: Same Street After Dark
tests: Tests day-to-night relighting without replacing the scene or altering its subjects and layout.

faults.what: Some hard-edged daylight-style shadow patterns remain on the left storefront and pavement, making the nighttime lighting slightly less convincing.

judge.summary: The edit convincingly turns the preserved street scene into nighttime, though some residual daylight-shaped shadows remain.

must_haves.item: The scene clearly reads as nighttime rather than sunny morning or sunset.
must_haves.why: The dark blue sky, subdued buildings, and glowing streetlamp clearly establish nighttime.

must_haves.item: The street and shop architecture retain their original shapes and positions.
must_haves.why: The storefronts, windows, street, pavement, and street furniture retain their original geometry and placement.

must_haves.item: The pedestrian remains on the right in the same pose and blue jacket.
must_haves.why: The pedestrian remains in the same position and walking pose, with the blue jacket preserved.

must_haves.item: Nighttime illumination is coherent, with the original strong daylight appearance removed.
must_haves.why: The overall daylight appearance is removed, with restrained warm illumination and a lit overhead lamp, although some original hard shadow patterns persist.

must_haves.item: The original wide composition is preserved, with no new subjects or objects.
must_haves.why: The framing and wide street perspective are unchanged, and no new subjects or objects are visible.
